name: Xue Hua
source:
This is a small, warm story that happened in the winter. Two people who met by chance, because of each other's existence, and then felt more past that had not been deliberately remembered - After telling the story, I finally ushered in the day when the first snow fell.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/965860/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
这是一个发生在冬日、温暖而短小的故事。两人因偶然相遇，又因为彼此的存在，感受到那些从未刻意回忆的过去——故事讲完后，初雪终于降临。

（来源：[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/965860/]Steam[/url]）
